In first line there is one integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105) — number of cafes indices written by Vlad.

In second line, n numbers a1, a2, ..., an (0 ≤ ai ≤ 2·105) are written — indices of cafes in order of being visited by Vlad. Vlad could visit some cafes more than once. Note that in numeration, some indices could be omitted. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
